title: Easy, Attractive, DOES NOT MUTE GLARE
text: Easy, Attractive, DOES NOT MUTE GLARE. I have french doors leading to my yard from my home office. The morning glare is harsh and prevents me from clearly viewing my desktop computer. Previously I've hung curtains to mute the glare but wanted to update the room since I'm doing basically a 'whole home' makeover.  I like this window cling material and it was truly VERY easy to put up. Today is the first 'morning glare' since I installed it yesterday afternoon. While still attractive and colorful, this product does NOTHING to reduce the glare. I ended up hanging up the curtains again. I won't remove the film since it does provide a level of privacy, but it didn't work as I had hoped.
